answer: Every new agent must post a 90 POA bond and route payouts through a copper escrow that releases 1/9 per epoch, so rewards arrive over nine epochs. Creating N fakes costs 90N POA tied up for nine epochs, so 1,000 fakes freeze 90,000 POA, while an honest user bonds 90 once. Auditors replay 8% of tasks at the harbor checkpoint; if two accounts show the same comet-like timing and output delta, both lose 75% of the bond, so each added fake raises expected loss linearly.
